connection_setting_review.finding_disposition: The claim that enabling password encryption must retroactively encrypt pre-existing plaintext connections is unestablished by retained native evidence and conflicts with the documented creation/update encryption boundary. No migration or kms:Encrypt-on-read mechanism was added; connection projection implementation remains unchanged.

quotes: The data structure used by the Data Catalog to encrypt the password as part of CreateConnection or UpdateConnection and store it in the ENCRYPTED_PASSWORD field in the connection properties.
When the ReturnConnectionPasswordEncrypted flag is set to "true", passwords remain encrypted in the responses of GetConnection and GetConnections.

If connection password protection is enabled, the caller of CreateConnection and UpdateConnection needs at least kms:Encrypt permission on the specified AWS KMS key, to encrypt passwords before storing them in the Data Catalog.

primary_sources.quote: When the connection was created or updated, an option in the Data Catalog settings determined whether the password was encrypted, and if so, what AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key was specified.
Set this parameter when the caller might not have permission to use the AWS KMS key to decrypt the password, but it does have permission to access the rest of the connection properties.

connection_setting_review.retained_native_evidence: testdata/aws/glue/controls_native.json: get-data-catalog-encryption-settings reports ReturnConnectionPasswordEncrypted=false. No retained native transition fixture establishes retroactive handling of an old plaintext row.
connection_setting_review.supported_local_proof: Create plaintext connection; enable setting; explicit UpdateConnection fails under current kms:Encrypt Deny, succeeds after policy replacement; GetConnection/GetConnections return ciphertext. Disable encrypted return; both APIs fail under current kms:Decrypt Deny, HidePassword succeeds, restored permission returns original synthetic password using actual KMS owner.
connection_setting_review.remaining_uncertainty: Native response for a pre-existing plaintext row immediately after changing the account setting was not observed. The local observation is retained, not asserted as a new AWS guarantee.
